title: Thy Neighbor's Vote: Peer Effects in Proxy Voting
near_miss_reason: Event-aligned (stacked-type) close-vote RD-DiD: each close governance-proposal vote at a publicly traded financial institution is an event (event_id) with its own +/-12-month window around the vote date (07OwnEffects.sas lines 9-14), and votes of the same institution are duplicated across events. Narrow passes (pass = 1) are compared with narrow rejections; post is defined relative to each event for passing and failing events alike and enters every column as a separate regressor (extra treatment regressor / event-time main effect for all units; mnsc.2023.4774 rule). Own effects (Table 3, 6A): reghdfe voteagainstmgmt pass_post post if abs_margin <= .025, absorb(itemonagendaid event_id [+ institution x agenda/industry/state or institution x firm FE]). Peer effects (Tables 4-7) add continuous FocalOwn interactions (pass_post_focalown, a treatment-intensity regressor) or Top10 triple interactions. Table 8 adds time-varying firm controls. No column with a single binary treatment, unit FE and calendar-time FE.
eligible_reason: Close-vote RD-DiD stacked by event with a post main effect in every column (and continuous ownership interactions in the peer-effect tables); not an eligible staggered TWFE specification. Licensed ISS Voting Analytics data not shipped.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe, cluster(event_id); SAS builds samples from ISS Voting Analytics, ISS Vote Results, Thomson 13F, CRSP/Compustat. Bandwidth abs_margin <= 0.025 (IA: 0.02, 0.03). Table 6 pre-trend placebo windows (votes_*_pr1). Internet Appendix: first-difference versions and wild-cluster bootstrap.
data_files_note: README: only institution locations (mgrno_loc) are posted; ISS Voting Analytics, ISS Vote Outcome, ISS-13F link and Thomson/CRSP/Compustat data are licensed and not shipped.
software_notes: SAS for sample construction, Stata for estimation.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (OpenAlex record has no abstract; candidates.csv lists year 2019, likely the working-paper date). Near miss by the Nov 1 coding rule (event-stacked design with extra post regressor); moot because data are not shipped.
